summary: Comprehensive testing of Stumble Chat anonymous chat app completed. All backend APIs and Socket.IO real-time features are working correctly. Frontend UI is functional and responsive. Photo disappearing feature could not be fully tested via automation (requires two browser sessions viewing same photo).

issues: Animation image has dark background that slightly clashes with gradient effect - minor aesthetic issue

passed_tests: Backend API /api/stats - returns online users, chats today, cities data
Backend API /api/check-ip - returns blocked status correctly
Socket.IO polling transport accessible via public URL
Socket.IO message exchange between matched users works
Socket.IO report user with chat history works
Home page loads with Connect button, stats (Online Now, Chats Today, Cities)
Waiting page shows with animation image when Connect is clicked
Cancel button on waiting page returns to home
Settings page navigation and form works
Mobile responsiveness - UI adapts properly to mobile viewport
critical_code_review_comments: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies (detectLocation, initPeer) - not causing issues but should be addressed for best practices
Photo disappearing logic implemented correctly - photo stays until opened, then 15s timer, disappears for both users showing 'Photo deleted'
seed_data_creation: None - anonymous chat app with no persistent data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Socket.IO real-time features tested via python-socketio client. Two-user matching, messaging, report, and skip all working. Photo feature (send, view, 15s timer, delete) is implemented but couldn't be fully E2E tested via single browser automation - requires manual testing with two browser sessions. IP blocking after 3 reports logic is implemented in backend.

features_verified.connection_stability: VERIFIED - Socket.IO with reconnection logic (10 attempts) and heartbeat (25s ping interval)
features_verified.report_user: VERIFIED - Saves entire chat history with optional comments, report modal working
features_verified.ip_blocking: IMPLEMENTED - Auto-blocks IPs with 3+ reports for 3 days (backend logic verified)
features_verified.photo_disappearing: IMPLEMENTED - Photo stays until opened, then 15s timer, disappears for both users showing 'Photo deleted' (UI components present, full E2E requires two browsers)
features_verified.waiting_animation: VERIFIED - GIF showing two people stumbling upon each other displayed correctly
